name: Incident Response Triage
description: Intake a security alert or incident description, extract IOCs, generate SIEM detection queries for Splunk/Elastic/Sentinel, and produce prioritised containment steps.
author: PortableLM

steps.prompt:
You are a senior incident responder. Given this alert or incident description:
{{input}}

Extract and return as structured JSON:
1) All IOCs: IPs, hashes (MD5/SHA1/SHA256), domains, URLs, file paths, registry keys, user accounts, process names, service names, mutexes
2) Attack timeline (if determinable)
3) Affected systems and assets
4) Initial classification: severity (critical/high/medium/low), category (malware/intrusion/data-exfil/lateral-movement/privilege-escalation/c2/other)
5) Confidence level (high/medium/low)
6) Gaps in evidence that need filling

Using this triage data:
{{triage_data}}

And MITRE ATT&CK mapping:
{{mitre_mapping}}

Generate:
1) Splunk SPL detection queries
2) Elastic KQL detection queries
3) Microsoft Sentinel KQL detection queries
4) Immediate containment steps ordered by priority (isolate/block/disable/preserve)
5) Evidence to collect: memory dumps, disk images, log sources, network captures
6) Escalation recommendation with justification
